features.quote: the magnificent Ibis Styles Toulouse Labège hotel transforms into a venue entirely dedicated to dance
features.rationale: The description presents the event as held in the hotel where guests sleep, so the parties and accommodation share one venue.

features.quote: renowned instructors will share their passion through classes and workshops open to all skill levels
features.rationale: Dance classes and workshops are stated as part of the weekend.

features.quote: Whether you are a beginner, an experienced dancer, or simply a music lover, there is a place for everyone in this adventure.
